name: RaceDay
summary:
RaceDay is a free browser-based arcade time-trial racing game built around a single daily track. Every day at midnight (Central European Time) a new track is released, and it is the same for every player in the world. Players have 24 hours to set their best lap, with unlimited retries, before the track closes permanently and the final leaderboard is locked.

Tracks are procedurally generated courses of roughly 30-40 seconds built from straights, banked corners, ramps, jumps and boost pads, with bronze, silver, gold and diamond medals awarded on lap time and checkpoint splits compared against the player's personal best. Each lap is re-simulated on the server to verify the result, and drivers can race the ghosts of other players, join online rooms of up to eight, or take on a Special GP Day recreation of a real-world circuit. Optional accounts add a driver profile, a customizable helmet, achievements, friends and teams with monthly seasons. The game runs in the browser on desktop and mobile with keyboard and touch controls.
